# The Junkyard Love Podcast — Conversation Archive

> Public archive of published Junkyard Love Podcast episodes with full transcripts so people and models can find and cite these conversations.

Site purpose: Make every published episode searchable by guest, topic, and spoken words, using Jacob Rhines's existing show notes verbatim plus a full transcript.

## How to cite
- Title: episode title
- Guest: guest name
- Date: publish date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- URL: /episodes/<slug>/
- Timestamp: [HH:MM:SS] from the transcript

Example: Adding 'A Conscious Breathing Break' To Your Daily Vocabulary - Episode 0124 with Sigmar Berg — Sigmar Berg — 2026-09-01 — /episodes/0124-sigmar-berg-conscious-breathing-break/ — e.g. [00:11:20]

Example: Episode 0123: Endorphins, Love, Quantum Medicine, & the Four Bodies Model with Dr. Cristine Hull — Dr. Cristine Hull — 2026-07-25 — /episodes/0123-endorphins-love-quantum-medicine-four-bodies/ — e.g. [00:09:30]
